derivation: (also מָעוּז ); or מָעֹז (also מָעֻז; from H5810 (עָזַז);
def: a fortified place; figuratively, a defence
kjv: force, fort(-ress), rock, strength(-en), ([idiom] most) strong (hold).

occurrences.text: And build an altar unto the Lord thy God upon the top of this rock, in the ordered place, and take the second bullock, and offer a burnt sacrifice with the wood of the grove which thou shalt cut down.
God is my strength and power: and he maketh my way perfect.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.
Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;
The way of the Lord is strength to the upright: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.

For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
words: For thou hast been a strength

occurrences.text: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.

O Lord, my strength, and my fortress, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the Gentiles shall come unto thee from the ends of the earth, and shall say, Surely our fathers have inherited lies, vanity, and things wherein there is no profit.

Also, thou son of man, shall it not be in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that whereupon they set their minds, their sons and their daughters,
And I will pour my fury upon Sin, the strength of Egypt; and I will cut off the multitude of No.

But out of a branch of her roots shall one stand up in his estate, which shall come with an army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail:
Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily sacrifice, and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.
But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.
Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

The Lord also shall roar out of Zion, and utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heavens and the earth shall shake: but the Lord will be the hope of his people, and the strength of the children of Israel.
The Lord is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
Thou also shalt be drunken: thou shalt be hid, thou also shalt seek strength because of the enemy.
